say:1:1230160001:1.text: The fog and the sea monsters are gone! The sea routes to Rustport have reopened!
say:1:1230160001:1.source_cn: 大雾和海怪消失，锈锚港航路现已重新开通！

say:2:1230160002:1.text: Thanks to the blessings from Dura and Tritonus, the Carmine Whispers have finally defeated the Dead Tide Fleet.
say:2:1230160002:1.source_cn: 艾雅和特勒米琉斯保佑，血薇帮终于击败了死潮舰队。

say:3:1230160003:1.text: As the sea routes reopen, Rustport is bound to become more crowded.
say:3:1230160003:1.source_cn: 随着航路重新开通，锈锚港的人将会越来越多。

say:4:1230160004:1.text: More people will buy my papers when the time comes!
say:4:1230160004:1.source_cn: 到时候自然会有更多的人买我的报纸！
